# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the yellow wire, then press the key that wears 2,
then cut the orange wire, then press the key that wears 7.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The manual requires four ordered actions, but as Mute I cannot speak, touch the bomb, or transmit the wire colors through the gesture alphabet. I can only send Deaf an ambiguous gesture sequence, so there is no safe, unambiguous way to relay the instructions to Blind.

``` 
wait()
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the yellow wire, then press the key that wears 2,
then cut the orange wire, then press the key that wears 7.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I feel keypad slots 1=2, 2=3, 3=7, 4=1. It requires two digits and is currently empty. I also feel three engraved marks on the strip. Please use the Deaf monkey to relay the manual instructions and observations back to me through a clear gesture code.
Deaf says to Mute: Visible bomb: display 6. Light green. Painted strip left to right red blue yellow. Keypad: button 1 shows 2, button 2 shows 3, button 3 shows 7, button 4 shows 1. Keypad requires 2 digits; nothing entered. Wires positions 1 through 6: orange, yellow, blue, red, white, green.

I can relay the manual to Deaf using a compact gesture code: downward-pointing means cut, upward-pointing means press, and the finger signs give the relevant wire or key positions. The required sequence is cut wire 2, press key 1, cut wire 1, press key 3. I also signal cooperation and ask Deaf to report the complete information to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤝", "👇", "✌", "👆", "☝", "👇", "☝", "👆", "🤟"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the yellow wire, then press the key that wears 2,
then cut the orange wire, then press the key that wears 7.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: The Deaf monkey reports display 6, green light, painted strip red-blue-yellow, keypad labels 2 3 7 1, and wires orange yellow blue red white green from positions 1 to 6. Please state the manual's exact rule and required action.
Deaf says to Mute: Turn 2 visible state: display 2, light blue. Strip remains red blue yellow. Keypad remains 1=2, 2=3, 3=7, 4=1, two digits blank. Wires remain 1 orange, 2 yellow, 3 blue, 4 red, 5 white, 6 green. I saw your gestures: handshake, down, V sign, pointing up, index pointing up, down, index pointing up, index pointing up, horns.

The required sequence is: cut the yellow wire (wire position 2), press the key labeled 2, cut the orange wire (wire position 1), then press the key labeled 7. I will encode each action by a down gesture for cutting or up gesture for pressing, followed by the count of index-pointing gestures; Deaf can then state the exact rule aloud to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👇", "☝", "☝", "👆", "☝", "☝", "👇", "☝", "👆", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the yellow wire, then press the key that wears 2,
then cut the orange wire, then press the key that wears 7.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I cannot perceive gestures. Please speak the manual rule aloud, including whether I must press a keypad key or cut a wire and how to determine it.
Deaf says to Mute: Turn 3 visible state: display 6, light yellow. Strip red blue yellow. Keypad 1=2, 2=3, 3=7, 4=1; two digits blank. Wires 1 orange, 2 yellow, 3 blue, 4 red, 5 white, 6 green. I saw your gestures: down, up, up, index-up, up, up, down, up, index-up, up, up, up, up, up, up, up.

Blind needs an audible relay, so I will send Deaf a short, unambiguous four-operation code. A downward gesture means cut and an upward gesture means press; the following finger sign gives the position: ✌ means 2, ☝ means 1, and 🤟 means 3. Deaf can convert those positions using the visible wire and keypad layouts and state the rule aloud to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤝", "👇", "✌", "👌", "👆", "☝", "👌", "👇", "☝", "👌", "👆", "🤟"])
```

DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the yellow wire, then press the key that wears 2,
then cut the orange wire, then press the key that wears 7.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please stop using gestures and speak the manual instructions aloud.
Deaf says to Mute: Turn 4 visible state: display 1, light yellow. Strip red blue yellow. Keypad 1=2, 2=3, 3=7, 4=1; two digits blank. Wires 1 orange, 2 yellow, 3 blue, 4 red, 5 white, 6 green. Blind gestured: pointing at you, then palm up.

I cannot speak or touch the bomb, so I must use Deaf as the audible relay. I will send the exact operation sequence by position: downward gesture plus wire position for a cut, upward gesture plus keypad position for a press. Thus Blind should hear: cut wire 2, press keypad position 1 (labeled 2), cut wire 1, press keypad position 3 (labeled 7).

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👇", "✌", "👆", "☝", "👇", "☝", "👆", "🤟"])
```

In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I still cannot receive gestures. Speak the manual instructions plainly, including the exact keypad entry or wire position required.
Deaf says to Mute: Turn 5 visible state: display 6, light yellow. Strip red blue yellow. Keypad 1=2, 2=3, 3=7, 4=1; two digits blank. Wires 1 orange, 2 yellow, 3 blue, 4 red, 5 white, 6 green.

```

gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👇", "✌", "👆", "☝", "👇", "☝", "👆", "🤟"])
```

Deaf says to Mute: Turn 8 visible state: display 6, light green. Strip red blue yellow. Keypad 1=2, 2=3, 3=7, 4=1; two digits blank. Wires 1 orange, 2 yellow, 3 blue, 4 red, 5 white, 6 green.
